---
title: "Hazelnut analyses"
description: "Seasons, export markets, crop size and frost, the Giresun and Ordu exchanges, and how the price forecasts scored."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "manifest.json")

# Title and one-line summary per analysis (hazelnut copy); the list and its order come
# from crops.yml `analyses`.
ENTRIES = {
    "seasonality": ("Seasonality",
                    "Does the price follow the harvest calendar? A little, and less than you might think."),
    "exports": ("Exports",
                "Where the shelled nuts go, how that has shifted, and what a kilo of kernels earns."),
    "crop-and-frost": ("Crop and frost",
                       "Bigger crops, lower prices, and how much a count of spring frost days explains."),
    "exchanges": ("Giresun and Ordu",
                  "Two exchanges, one market: how far apart their prices run."),
    "forecasting": ("Forecasting",
                    "Every method we tried against \"the price stays where it is\", and an honest range."),
}

stamp = ""
if manifest is not None:
    stamp = (f'<span class="live"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>'
             f'{ph.escape(ph.as_of_stamp(manifest))}</span>')
ph.raw_html(
    '<div class="dash-head"><div>'
    f'<span class="eyebrow">Crops / {ph.escape(crop.name)} / Analyses</span>'
    "<h1>What the data says, and how sure we are</h1></div>"
    f"{stamp}</div>"
    '<p class="lede">Each analysis opens with what we found in plain words, then shows the '
    "charts and tables behind it. Every number on these pages is computed from the same "
    "data the dashboard uses.</p>"
)
```

```{python}
ph.raw_html(ph.analyses_list_html(crop.analyses, ENTRIES))
```
